proposal:
Expose ParameterSet as a documented public pytest type

Export `pytest.ParameterSet` for annotating helpers returning `pytest.param()`, identify its module as `pytest`, and warn on unsupported direct construction. Preserve warning-free factories, values, marks, IDs, tuple behavior and serialization. Add documentation, regression tests and a typing check.

Verification: compilation, whitespace checks and all 11 new contract tests passed. Mark/expression suites recorded 288 passes and one expected failure; the sole configuration-related example lookup failure passed on rerun with the example directory configured. Independent design and implementation reviews passed.

Static typing, lint and documentation builds remain unverified because their tools are unavailable offline. Changes remain in the checkout.
